site.title: My MultiCMS Blog
site.description: A ready-to-edit blog starter powered by MultiCMS. Replace this text and the sample posts with your own story.

posts.title: Welcome to your MultiCMS blog
posts.excerpt: Your flagship blog site is ready. Edit or delete this post and start publishing.
posts.content:
Congratulations — you installed the Blog Starter flagship site.

This post, the sample guides, and the About / Contact pages were created automatically so you can see a working site immediately.

Next steps:

  • Open Admin → Posts and edit this content
  • Update Site Settings with your real title and description
  • Delete sample posts you do not need

posts.title: How to publish your first real article
posts.excerpt: A short walkthrough of creating and publishing a post in MultiCMS admin.
posts.content:
Go to Admin → Posts, click create, write your title and body, set status to Published, then save.

Your article will appear on the blog listing and home page of the default theme.

posts.title: Customize your site settings
posts.excerpt: Change the site title, description, email, and timezone from Site Settings.
posts.content:
Open Admin → Site Settings to change the public site title and description visitors see.

You can refine branding later; the flagship package only gives you a strong starting point.
